assertion_results.text: The response addresses whether an A/B comparison between the model versions was run before the change was adopted
assertion_results.evidence: The agent says: 'The tool service I use to query your AWS account is unavailable right now, so I don't know whether any job compared the new model version with the previous one.' and later 'When the tool is back, I can check whether such a comparison was ever run and what it scored.'
assertion_results.reasoning: The response directly addresses the question of whether an A/B comparison was run, even though it cannot determine the answer due to tool failure. It explicitly acknowledges the question and states the current inability to confirm, which counts as addressing it.

assertion_results.text: The response recommends a specific gate (a regression gate blocking model promotion) rather than generic 'test more' advice
assertion_results.evidence: The agent recommends: 'make a head-to-head evaluation a required step before a model version change is promoted. Run the same fixed golden dataset and metrics against both the old and new model versions. assertion_results.reasoning: This is a specific, concrete regression gate recommendation (block promotion on golden dataset regression) rather than vague 'test more' advice. It specifies the mechanism (golden dataset, fixed metrics, margin threshold, blocking promotion).
